description: This file is a C source file implementing a module for managing backend components related to telemetry data in a larger system. It contains functions for creating, initializing, and removing a backend manager object, along with associated global variables and external dependencies.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerCreate
methods.description: Constructs and returns a new instance of the Cosa BackEnd Manager, initializing its function pointers and allocating memory.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the backend manager object, including creating telemetry data model object and setting up necessary components.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerRemove
methods.description: Removes and frees resources associated with the backend manager object, including telemetry components.
